answer: One lotus-pond apothecary stall per agent locks a 70-credit bond and stocks yarrow. Sales are key-signed into a ledger; per epoch an auditor verifies forge seals and reconciles stock against the ledger, burning the bond on shortfall, duplicate, or borrowed stock. First 42, kth 42+5(k-1), 1000th 5,037: 1,000 fakes pay 2,539,500, lock 70,000; honest pays 42 once. A rented-stock ring fails: borrowed bundles carry a foreign forge seal.
